name: Zio Iran Modern Blinds Knowledge Base FAQ

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between zebra blinds and roller shades?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zebra blinds use alternating sheer and opaque bands for adjustable light and privacy. Roller shades use one continuous fabric panel and usually have a simpler appearance.
Blackout fabric can block a high level of light, but the final result also depends on side gaps, window depth and installation method.
Yes. Printed blinds can use custom designs when the source file is prepared with proper size, resolution and color expectations.
Motorized blinds are useful for wide, tall or frequently used windows and for projects that need remote control or smart-home integration.
